findings.claim: I-003 (public API of NaruServe-api must not expose java.nio.file, CompletableFuture or java.net.http types) is still mapped by no AC tag and no recorded decision. Round 1 fixed the checks (forbidden list extended, new class-reference test i003_...), and the code complies, but the design row stays unmapped under the frozen rule (the I-003 comments sit in a test only).
findings.suggested_fix: Record I-003 as a wave decision pointing at ClassConstraintsTest#i003_noMainClassOfTheApiModuleReferencesNioFileCompletableFutureOrJavaNetHttp and CON-HTTP-002 AC-1 (the verified ACs cannot take a new tag), or add an unverified successor AC tagged [I-003].

findings.claim: The NoLeftoverThreads rule added for I-015 is narrower than the invariant: it waits only for naruserve-* threads, so tinyhttpd-acceptor-<port> and tinyhttpd-watchdog (counted as app threads by FR-APP-020 AC-9 and PERF-APP-001) and the upload temp files are not checked by it in the socket tests. TinyHttpdWebSocketTest and WebSocketThreadsSocketTest, which call listen(0), do not carry the rule either.
findings.suggested_fix: Let the rule also match tinyhttpd-acceptor-/tinyhttpd-watchdog threads started during the test (or state the narrower scope in I-015's realisation), and add the rule to the two classes.

findings.claim: On the default TinyHttpd adapter every D-052 path rejection (/a%2Fb, /a%zz, /a%C3%28, /%2e%2e, /a/./b, /a%00b, /a/../b) is answered by TinyHttpd itself with a plain-text 'HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request' (Content-Type text/plain, body '400 Bad Request', Connection: close), never reaching the Dispatcher: no standard error JSON, no onError, no access-log line. Verified live with a raw socket against RestApp.create(). The SRS (04.http-core FR-HTTP-021 AC-3, verified) states the standard error body for a PathValidator rejection, and docs/api/routing.md 'Path rejection and decoding' says only that the request is rejected. The plain-text deviation is recorded only as an SDS decision in 06.engine-adapter FR-ENGINE-007 AC-2 ('TinyHttpd may reject them with its own plain-text 400') and the CrossAdapterTest compares status only. docs/api/defaults.md:103 lists the plain-text TinyHttpd 400 cases as 'malformed request format' and never names path rejections, while docs/api/servlet.md:150-161 documents the body source per case for the Servlet adapter. A user of the default adapter who reads routing.md/middleware.md expects the JSON body and an access-log line for these requests.
findings.evidence: docs/api/routing.md:271-282 (path rejection section, no response format); docs/api/defaults.md:103 (plain-text list without path rejections); docs/spec/04.http-core.srs.md:2927 (FR-HTTP-021 AC-3 standard body) vs docs/spec/06.engine-adapter.srs.md:803 (plain-text 400 allowed); NaruServe-tinyhttpd/src/test/java/com/snoworca/naruserve/tinyhttpd/BothAdaptersCases.java:77-92 (status-only comparison)
findings.suggested_fix: Add one sentence to docs/api/routing.md (path rejection section) and to the plain-text list in docs/api/defaults.md: on the TinyHttpd adapter a rejected path gets TinyHttpd's short text/plain 400 without onError, standard JSON or access-log line, while the Servlet adapter follows the table in servlet.md. No code change needed.

findings.claim: The round-1 fix for I-015 is incomplete in what it watches. The NoLeftoverThreads rule only looks at threads whose name starts with 'naruserve-', but the TinyHttpd adapter also starts 'tinyhttpd-acceptor-<port>' and 'tinyhttpd-watchdog' (observed live while an app runs; both vanish after shutdown). They are server threads of the app (docs/api/defaults.md counts them in the 452 thread total, and TinyHttpdAdapter.release() waits for them), so a test class that carries the rule still passes if the engine acceptor or watchdog is left behind. The round-1 suggested fix named 'naruserve-<port>-* / tinyhttpd-*', and RawTargetSocketTest.java:294-300 already treats these two names as the app's live threads, so the shared rule is inconsistent with the existing isolated test.
findings.suggested_fix: Let the rule take a list of prefixes (or add a second LiveThreads.withPrefix('tinyhttpd-') pass) so the TinyHttpd socket tests also fail on a leftover tinyhttpd-acceptor-*/tinyhttpd-watchdog; keep the 'before' snapshot so other apps' threads stay ignored.

findings.claim: The recorded full-suite run in the release records is attributed to the wrong commit. docs/release/test-results.md says 'commit=3806d59; tests=1566', but the message of 3806d59 says 'build at 1561 tests'; 1566 is the count of the f357caf tree (five tests added by NoLeftoverThreads and the I-003 checks). Re-running ./gradlew build --rerun-tasks at f357caf gives exit 0 and 1566 tests, so the figure is right and the commit field is not: a reader who checks out the named commit gets 1561.
findings.evidence: docs/release/test-results.md:98; git show -s 3806d59 (message: 'build at 1561 tests, 0 failures')
findings.suggested_fix: Record the run against the commit that contains the 1566-test tree (or write 'working tree on 3806d59 with the round-1 fixes' as the earlier record did) instead of 3806d59.
